diagnosis: ConsentFormPolicy#destroy? validates clinic_id equality but allows any clinic staff member, including desk receptionists, to permanently delete signed surgical and HIPAA consent waivers across unrelated doctors in multi-practice facilities.

corrected_code:
class ConsentFormPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  def destroy?
    return false unless user.present? && record.patient.clinic_id == user.clinic_id
    user.clinic_director? || (user.physician? && record.assigned_doctor_id == user.id)
  end
end

class Clinic::ConsentFormsController < ApplicationController
  def destroy
    @form = ConsentForm.find(params[:id])
    authorize @form

    @form.destroy!
    head :no_content
  end
end
